Request: Create a definition list with these term and description pairs: DNS: Looks up the address for a domain.; URL: Identifies a resource location.
Answer:
<dl>
  <dt>DNS</dt>
  <dd>Looks up the address for a domain.</dd>
  <dt>URL</dt>
  <dd>Identifies a resource location.</dd>
</dl>

Request: Create a definition list with these term and description pairs: Tab: Moves to the next editable field.; Escape: Closes the current dialog.
Answer:

  <dt>Tab</dt>
  <dd>Moves to the next editable field.</dd>
  <dt>Escape</dt>
  <dd>Closes the current dialog.</dd>
</dl>
